titleInfo.title: Cigarette case from World War II

mods.abstract: The cigarette case is engraved by hand on the outside. One side of the case is engraved with a horse, horseshoe, and "1944". The other side of the case is engraved with a portrait. The case was owned by a member of the U.S. Army 8th Evacuation Hospital unit during World War II.
mods.note: Photographed by Claude Moore Health Sciences Library, Historical Collections and Services staff.
